Chief Executive's Order No.2 of 2002.‑‑In the said Order, after
paragraph 5, the following new paragraph shall be inserted, namely:‑‑
"5A. Appointment of
Advisors.‑‑(1) The Chief Executive may appoint Advisors in the
Committee on such terms and conditions as he may determine.
(2) An Advisor shall be entitled
to such privileges and allowances as are admissible to a Member or as may be
determined by the Chief Executive."
